Evidence limitation: no full suite was rerun. The baseline log has a segmentation fault and no summary/native exit, and the after arm was not executed. added_failure_count is null and added_failure_ids is empty as unavailable evidence, not a measured zero. The known predeclared root-route failure in the focused P100 log is not assigned to the unidentified baseline F marker.

Physical receipts read directly: fitted-observation-replay-1318855/{mastu,tcv,iter}/*-row-replay.json and gate.log each finish EXIT=0. MAST-U loop/probe relative L2 = 0.0012641012612455412 / 0.0010252620601982304; TCV = 0.0016982263557521813 / 0.0019015528117356548; ITER = 0.007242617899855864 / 0.0008395208013880012. Zero-reference families report null relative error, not a fictitious zero. The source-path and module-hash headers in the focused/physical gate logs bind those results to 24f72a6d2e95e1c91d906156ea3500bc65a9d13c, followed only by documentation/figure commits at the reviewed head.

Assertion reading: no added assertion was found whose claimed numerical regression protection is tautological because both sides merely reuse the supplied value. Tests of metadata copying are narrower serialization checks, not proof of physical correctness. In particular result['trips'] == history.active_set_iterations at tests/test_equilibrium_magnetics_fit.py:99 is an independent expected count of 4 against a recorded result; reinstating the finite-entry count returns 3 and reddens it. The conductor-fit test independently builds its design and solves it with numpy.linalg.lstsq; restoring fixed conductor currents or ignoring their unequal uncertainty changes the expected coefficients and residuals. Assertion-level conditions are recorded in assertion-audit.json.

Production reachability: the new inverse class/current-fitting mode has no production constructor call outside tests at this revision; the public export does not itself count as a call site. Existing production consumers of Magnetics.project and score_with_efit_referee were read, and their default paths retain their prior behavior. Segmented geometry explicitly refuses on project() and is used by the new fitter rather than silently misprojected by those older consumers.

Figure verification limitation: fresh rendering was attempted as a separate all_debug batch and refused before submission with 'Error creating slurm stream socket: Operation not permitted' / 'Unable to contact slurm controller (connect failure)'. No solver, field evaluation or figure batch ran on the fleet node. Existing producer PNGs for the latest refused response and all three fitted-source replays were visually inspected: legends are clear and text is readable; these inspections do not claim a fresh render of all 16 committed SVGs. The full independent figure-render requirement therefore remains open under this sandbox.
